notes: Cheapest Ariya found and a strong individual history: clean title, 0 accidents, 1 private owner (not a stated lease return), full ProPILOT Assist safety suite, heated front/rear seats, heated wheel, leather, memory seat. 63 kWh battery, 216 mi EPA range (FWD). Price is roughly 39% below the ~$43k original MSRP after 3 years — consistent with the Ariya's well-documented steep depreciation, not necessarily a red flag on this specific car. Same caveats as every Ariya here: 3 of its 4 recalls are propulsion-loss and Nissan has discontinued the model for the US as of MY2026.
checks: Not a stated lease return like the other two — ask directly what the prior use was

RUN THE VIN — three of the Ariya's four recalls are propulsion-loss (inverter x2, traction motor); the fourth is a steering wheel bolt that can detach. Check this VIN specifically before anything else.

Nissan discontinued the Ariya for the US starting MY2026 — factor that into how long you plan to keep it and what it will be worth when you sell
No federal or Arizona EV tax credit currently applies — do not price this expecting one
